scope: Owner requested correction of all stylistically inconsistent existing enemy illustrations, 2026-09-12. No mechanics changes. Production integration remains after creative preview/approval under the existing pipeline.

wild_dog: Individual photographic fur strands and granular hide; compare clean grouped hair/shading on hunter_male.
Lean feral brown-black dog, amber eyes, narrow muzzle, torn ear, restrained healed scars, small scruffy tail, exactly four canine legs. Do not make it the much larger spiked wolf or a cute pet.
slime: Photographic liquid caustics and tiny specular droplets obscure the contour.

Low inky translucent teal-blue slime, jagged open monster mouth, purple eye slits and a small violet internal core. Fluid curling silhouette with a few connected lobes. No humanoid skeleton or legs, no cute spherical jelly. Render translucency as painted color planes, not PBR glass or photoreal liquid.
boar: Fine bristles, leathery snout and crack microtexture overwhelm grouped forms.

Heavy charcoal/russet corrupted boar, enormous paired ivory tusks, raised bristled back with a restrained row of crimson corruption spikes and red fissure accents, small red eyes. Exactly four cloven-hoofed legs and curled tail. Do not turn it into a bear or wolf.
cursed_scarecrow: Straw, rope and rag microstrands are excessively realistic versus class clothing.

Cursed humanoid straw scarecrow in brown ragged coat and crooked wide-brim pointed hat, glowing crimson eyes inside a dark featureless cloth face, tied straw wrists and ankles, two long legs, hands holding a worn curved scythe. Group straw into deliberate bundles; keep all hands, feet and the complete scythe blade visible.
plains_spirit: Hairlike spectral cloth noise and realistic fabric tangles conflict with clean class silhouettes.

Hooded ghost of the dry Twilight Plains, muted charcoal-blue shroud, pale cyan eyes, rope ties and one cyan lantern hanging from a skeletal hand. The other bony hand reaches slightly toward the left in idle. Lower robe dissolves into a few connected flowing spectral ribbons; naturally limbless below, no invented boots, no detached mist cloud.
nature_guardian: Dense bark grooves and granular stone look like high-realism material render.

Large ancient treant guardian, humanoid bark/stone body, branch-antler crown, long root beard, restrained moss, warm amber heart core and carved amber rune on a broad wooden forearm shield. One open root hand, two heavy rooted feet. Chunky wood plates, not a dense maze of twigs. Keep earthy brown/grey/olive palette; not a green neon golem.
venom_spider: Photographic chitin/grit and moss strands; front-on pose should become left three-quarter.

Giant dark bark-armored venom spider, mossy brown-black chitin plates, chartreuse clustered eyes and two venom-tipped fangs, a bulbous raised abdomen with restrained yellow-green markings. Exactly eight articulated walking legs, no scorpion tail. Rotate to left-facing three-quarter with face and fangs on left, abdomen behind on right.
forest_cultist: Photographic moss, bone and rope surface noise across the whole figure.

Black Forest cultist wearing a deer-skull mask with branching antlers, dark olive hooded robes, layered bark/feather shoulder mantle, tied rope belts. Long wooden staff with small green orb, one free gloved hand, two booted feet. Do not reveal an anime human face through the skull. Keep deer mask, antlers and green ritual identity.
rotting_knight: Dense rust speckles and photographic decayed fabric; broad armor planes needed.

Undead knight in battered iron armor, narrow green-glowing visor, ragged grey-olive cloth, a skeletal rib motif on chest, worn sword held down-left and a chipped broad shield at the other arm. Two fully armored legs and boots. Corrosion in a few large painted patches, not tiny rust speckles or graphic gore.
corrupted_bear: Dense realistic fur and skin creases; purple corruption should remain a localized accent.

Large dark charcoal corrupted bear, violet eyes, a few violet fissures through shoulder/back and one foreleg, large curved claws. Same hefty bear anatomy and hunched braced combat idle, not humanoid or werewolf. Four connected bear limbs, rear paws grounded and forepaws readable. Group fur into broad dark tufts.
black_hart: Realistic hair and electrical scribbles make a noisy silhouette.

Lean black stag with branching dark antlers, dark plum-charcoal coat, a few restrained magenta corruption veins on chest/neck and eyes. Exactly four slim hooved legs, long neck, small deer tail. Calm threatening left-facing three-quarter idle. Keep antlers as clear branches, no detached lightning or generic demonic horns.
gallows_wraith: Photographic grey skin and fine shredded cloth unlike class illustrations.

Gallows wraith: gaunt pale grey adult undead figure, bowed head partly covered by dark grey hair, rope noose at neck, faded grey coat with ochre rope accents. Long bony hands, two bare spectral feet, a few long connected coat ribbons. Preserve suspended forlorn ghost identity, not hooded lantern ghost or generic armored skeleton.
blackwood_executioner: Photographic pores, bark and gritty metal overwhelm deliberate silhouette.

Huge adult forest executioner, dark iron box-shaped full-face helmet with slit, muscular bare upper arm, other shoulder and forearm engulfed in thick branch/root armor, ragged dark red-brown apron, heavy boots, large two-handed execution axe held low across body toward left. Keep bark asymmetry and restrained rust; no photoreal skin, no gore splatter.
bog_crawler: Photographic muddy hide and dense scales; shape readability is weak at battle size.

Low broad swamp reptile/amphibian, olive-brown muddy armored hide, blunt flattened head and long tapering tail curling around behind, four short stout legs with claws, broad dorsal ridges. Not a crocodile skeleton, not a dragon, no horns. Group hide into large plates and painted muddy patches.
drowned_dead: Photo-like dead skin, soaked fabric and stringy algae.

Drowned adult undead wanderer with pale slate-blue skin, dark wet hair, torn dark teal travel coat, rope bindings and a few broad strips of algae, boots, two reaching clawlike human hands. Hunched left-facing combat idle. Keep cool waterlogged identity without exposed organs or graphic wounds; simplify tears and wet reflections.
swamp_witch: Photographic skin, tiny braids and material grain differ from the mage reference.

Adult swamp witch, pale skin, long dark brown hair in a few large locks, dark olive-brown layered dress with asymmetric ragged skirt, leather boots and bracers, branch staff with curved sickle-like fork, one spellcasting hand. Preserve her mature face and swamp palette; anime fantasy features comparable to mage_female, not a child, no added revealing clothing or purple class costume.
bone_crocodile: Photographic bone pores, individual scales and muddy crevices.

Long low skeletal armored crocodile, ivory bone plates and dorsal bone spikes over dark olive hide, long toothed snout, tail curving upward behind, exactly four short jointed clawed legs. Keep recognizably crocodilian build, cream/olive palette, no extra legs, no dragon wings, no ground pile.
mist_walker: Fine reed strands, realistic flesh and bone grain turn its form into visual noise.

Tall marsh stalker with long bird-skull mask and beak, hunched lean humanoid body, reed/branch mantle and long claw fingers, two long digitigrade birdlike legs. Muted ochre reeds, brown-grey wood/bone, small dark eye socket. Group reeds into readable bundles, retain strange birdlike identity without background fog or additional birds.
drowned_mother: Photographic mature face/skin and thousands of moss/cloth strands.

Adult Drowned Mother boss, regal pale swamp sorceress with crown of reeds/roots and bone, long dark hair, full-length ragged grey-olive robes, bone-and-branch staff with a small skull/fetish and hanging ornaments. Two arms and bare feet visible. Preserve mature solemn face, imposing boss silhouette and muted marsh palette; no new outfit, no youthful chibi treatment.
boneburner: Realistic wood/bone grain and excessive fabric fraying.

Ashen skeletal boneburner: tall thin charred undead humanoid, skull head with ragged pale hair, orange ember glow inside ribs, long clawed hands, bony digitigrade feet, torn sand/red-brown cloth strips and a few bone/wood ties. Exactly two arms/two legs. Ember motif in broad controlled planes, no smoke field, no gore.
red_salamander: Photoreal scales and constant tiny orange highlights create a molten PBR look.

Crimson fire salamander, low four-legged reptile, long curling tail raised behind, red-orange crest and fins, dark red armored back, warm golden throat and orange glowing fissures. Keep reptilian salamander face, not a cute lizard or dragon with wings. Exactly four connected clawed limbs, tail and crests fully visible, fewer large scale groups.
hearth_devourer: Photographic charcoal/bone fragments and tiny ember points obscure limbs.

Hearth Devourer miniboss: towering charred skeletal demonic creature with long horned skull, orange furnace ribcage and throat, massive hooked claw hands, two sturdy digitigrade feet, a few chains and torn pale cloth banners. Retain charcoal/ember/ash identity; broad scorched plates, clear limbs, no extra minions or floating cinder cloud.
azhar: Realistic skin and fine grain on ornate bones/cloth clash with illustrated classes.

Azhar boss, tall mature male wasteland sovereign, long pale hair, thorn/bone crown, lean muscular torso partially covered by dark bronze/bone armor, layered tattered sand and rust-red robes, imposing curved polearm blade held downward-left. Preserve pale face, crown, long cloak silhouette and ochre/red/charcoal palette; do not turn him into a young hero or add blue/purple magic.
frozen_castaway: Dense icy microtexture and frayed cloth retain a more photographic look than the other Ice Coast enemies.

Frozen adult castaway with pale icy blue face, dark windblown hair, torn navy sailor coat, rope belt, frosted forearms and boots, worn cutlass in one hand and open icy hand toward left. Broad painted frost facets and ice accents, no particle cloud, no microcrystalline crust. Two full arms and legs; preserve grim mature undead sailor identity.

keep.sand_golem: Already predominantly large angular sandstone plates and controlled ochre shadows; material is not photographic skin/fur.
keep.desert_harpy: Anime face, grouped wing feathers and controlled rust/cream palette already fit class visual language.
keep.desert_wanderer: Anime face, purposeful cloak layers and clear blade silhouette fit class rendering.
keep.black_sea_siren: Stylized anime face, broad scale plates and navy/cyan shape language already consistent.
keep.ghost_ship_captain: Deliberate illustrated face, navy coat and gold weapon shapes; grim mature character is not itself a style failure.
keep.ice_bear: Already grouped white fur tufts, drawn outline and soft blue shading.
keep.snow_griffin: Large clear feather groups and white/gold anime-fantasy silhouette; no micro-fur realism.
keep.leviathan_north: Broad blue/turquoise scales and expressive illustrated silhouette already consistent.
keep.drowned_acolyte: Approved crypt set: anime face, coherent navy/ivory robes and order motifs.
keep.drowned_priestess: Approved crypt set: anime face and large navy/ivory fabric planes; runtime already flips her toward hero.
keep.iron_gate_guardian: Approved crypt set: chunky navy armor, broad metallic shading and readable shield.
keep.crypt_warden: Approved crypt set: drawn angular navy armor and controlled cyan accents.
keep.order_grandmaster: Approved crypt set: illustrated mature face and coherent navy/gold identity; runtime facing handled by existing flip.

unused.sunken_knight.png: Legacy realistic source is not referenced by combat catalog; leave archived, do not regenerate or reconnect.
